_comment: The tag vocabulary. scripts/check-song.mjs rejects a meta.tags entry that is not a key here, so a new tag is added here first, with a one-line meaning. Keep tags about what a parent would pick by: use, mood, what carries the sound.
bedtime: long settling before the night's sleep
naptime: shorter daytime settle; a parent may stop it after one pass
noise-bed: a band-limited pink or brown noise layer runs under the music (R10, R11)
heartbeat: a slow low pulse every beat or two, heartbeat-like (R3)
sway: the sound moves slowly from side to side or breathes in level, rocking-like, at about one swing every four seconds
pad-only: no melody layer; sustained chords only
reference: used by the lab as the level-matching reference (R18)
